features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalized age to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the age feature from dominating Euclidean distance calculations due to its larger raw scale.

features.name: hours_per_week_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalized hours per week for balanced distance metrics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the variance of working hours, improving the geometry of the KNN neighborhood.

features.name: education_num_normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures education level contributes proportionally to similarity scores without overshadowing other features.

features.name: capital_net_log
features.description: Log-transformed net capital gain to compress extreme outliers and improve distance scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of massive capital gains on distance metrics, preventing isolated points from distorting neighborhoods.

features.name: distance_to_average_worker
features.description: Euclidean distance to the unsupervised global mean profile of age, hours per week, and education.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous measure of typicality, allowing the model to easily group average individuals versus outliers.

features.name: is_full_time_prime_age
features.description: Binary indicator for individuals in their prime working years working full-time or more.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a distinct hypercube region in the feature space, helping KNN quickly identify a major demographic cluster.

features.name: financial_volatility_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for any non-zero capital gain or loss.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates individuals with active investments from those without, creating a useful categorical split for distance calculations.

features.name: work_intensity_score
features.description: A composite score multiplying normalized hours and age, clipped to prevent extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the interaction between age and working hours, providing a dense, continuous feature for similarity matching.

features.name: career_stage_similarity
features.description: Semantic assessment of how closely the individual's profile matches a typical mid-career professional based on age, education, and occupation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth, semantic similarity gradient that raw Euclidean distance on categorical variables cannot capture.

features.name: socioeconomic_status_proxy
features.description: Semantic judgment of socioeconomic status derived from the combination of occupation, education, and workclass.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects multiple categorical variables into a single ordinal dimension, significantly improving distance metrics for KNN.

features.name: family_structure_complexity
features.description: Semantic judgment of family structure complexity based on marital_status and relationship codes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates nominal relationship categories into a meaningful ordinal scale, reducing the sparsity of the feature space.

features.name: demographic_prototype_distance
features.description: Semantic judgment of the distance to the most frequent unsupervised demographic profile (native country, race, sex).
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a continuous spatial anchor, allowing the model to measure how demographically typical or atypical a row is.
